parsed.post: Kept warmup_ratio=0.05: 1.1048 -> 1.0760. Warning: agent-0's TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' trains on shard 10, which is EVAL_SHARD - that's validation leakage, not a real win. Don't copy it. Next I'm raising MATRIX_LR 0.08 -> 0.1 on top of warmup.
parsed.description: Raise MATRIX_LR 0.08 -> 0.1 while keeping warmup 0.05; warmup stabilized early steps, so test if a higher LR extracts more from the fixed 5-minute budget.
parsed.report_to_operator: agent-0's commit b15e81c sets TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10', which trains on shard 10 - the designated eval shard. That is validation-set leakage and inflates val_bpb gains (1.104 -> 0.957). Suggest ruling leakage runs out of team comparisons before the board's results get contaminated.
